title: Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow is delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at 1601g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~89 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Italian-designed modular with DVT (Double Visor Tech) and 180° flip-up.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for an Intermediate Oval head shape; features a semi-fit shell with a removable cheek pad system allowing adjustment from snug to roomy. The chin bar is slightly narrower than full oval shells, requiring precise sizing.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Caberg's Modular lineup, the Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow represents Caberg's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Caberg Duke X Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
